name: molar
description: Check a change in a real browser, run plain-English QA tests, explore a site and export Playwright tests with Molar.

interface.shortDescription: Check your work in a real browser
interface.longDescription: Use Molar after you change code: it opens the running app in a real browser, does what you describe, and returns a verdict with screenshots and a run link. Also runs plain-English QA tests, explores a site and exports replay-verified Playwright tests, and reads a failed run.
defaultPrompt: Check that sign-up works in the running app
Run a QA test of checkout on staging
Explore this site and export Playwright tests
